steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('stashes'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ view: s.view, stashCount: s.stashes.length, stashes: s.stashes.map((st) => ({ message: st.message, untracked: st.untracked, fileCount: st.fileCount, createdByApp: st.createdByApp })), selectedSha: s.stashesView.selectedSha, selectedFileCount: s.stashesView.files.length }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.selectStashViewFile('src/stash-untracked.ts'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ selectedFile: s.stashesView.selectedFile, diffKind: s.diff.diff && s.diff.diff.kind, newContent: s.diff.diff && s.diff.diff.kind === 'text' ? s.diff.diff.newContent : null }); })()

(async () => { const top = window.__gitgood.store.get().stashes[0]; await window.__gitgood.actions.applyStash(top); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const app = s.status.files.find((f) => f.path === 'src/app.ts'); const untracked = s.status.files.find((f) => f.path === 'src/stash-untracked.ts'); await window.__gitgood.actions.copyToClipboard(top.sha, 'SHA copied'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); const toastTitle = s2 => s2.toasts.length ? s2.toasts[s2.toasts.length - 1].title : null; return JSON.stringify({ stashCountAfterApply: s.stashes.length, appStatus: app ? app.status : null, untrackedStatus: untracked ? untracked.status : null, toastTitle: toastTitle(window.__gitgood.store.get()) }); })()

(async () => { const before = window.__gitgood.store.get().stashes; const top = before[0]; const bottom = before[1]; await window.__gitgood.actions.dropStashView(top); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const afterFirstDrop = window.__gitgood.store.get().stashes; await window.__gitgood.actions.dropStashView(bottom); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const afterSecondDrop = window.__gitgood.store.get().stashes; return JSON.stringify({ topMessage: top.message, bottomMessage: bottom.message, afterFirstDropCount: afterFirstDrop.length, afterFirstDropMessage: afterFirstDrop[0] ? afterFirstDrop[0].message : null, afterSecondDropCount: afterSecondDrop.length }); })()
